Messages.Author: Alec Habig
Messages.Body:
There are at least two cards out there (Auspex: Fast Reaction; Obf: Hidden
Lurker) that allow one of your other vampires to "enter combat" with one of the
bad guy vamps you just fought.

Our question is : is this a continuation of the same combat, or does it start a
new combat?  This matters for things that you get once per combat (shotgun,
manuevers, etc.) and for things that can only be played on later rounds of
combat (glaser rounds, those cool thaumaturgy cards).

I really want to use this Fast Reaction card with, say Walk of Fire or Cauldron
of Blood to give the big hee-ya to some poor schmuck who dared to block one of
my other actions :)

Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Alec Habig <ahabig@bigbang.astro.indiana.edu> wrote:
>There are at least two cards out there (Auspex: Fast Reaction; Obf: Hidden
>Lurker) that allow one of your other vampires to "enter combat" with one of
>the bad guy vamps you just fought.
>Our question is : is this a continuation of the same combat, or does it start
>a new combat?...

It's a brand spankin' new combat.  It starts on round 1, any ammo cards
or Traps or what have you will no longer be in effect, once-per-combat
weapons can be used again, and so on.
